meta.title: DoA Threshold Currency (approval.doa.currency) = GBP
gaps: Set the tenant-level approval.doa.currency setting to GBP and verify that Modular Approval Setup and the Delegation of Authority matrix use GBP for all spend threshold definitions.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Set the tenant-level approval.doa.currency setting to GBP and verify that Modular Approval Setup and the Delegation of Authority matrix use GBP for all spend threshold definitions.

args.need: as Tenant Admin, set approval.doa.currency to GBP, use Modular Approval Setup to make approvals attachable to entities, and open the Delegation of Authority matrix showing GBP as the currency for spend threshold definitions

steps.note: No catalog step can change the tenant setting, configure Modular Approval Setup, or inspect the DoA threshold matrix.
Check that the tester's resulting approval configuration or DoA matrix visibly shows GBP.
